audience: solar sales and design teams that plan systems and proposals in Aurora Solar

useCases.title: List the newest projects and their status
useCases.text: Read the tenant to see the valid statuses. List the newest projects and open one to read the customer, the address and the owner.

useCases.title: Compare the design of a project with its price
useCases.text: List the designs of a project. Read the system summary and the pricing of a design, with the price per watt, adders and incentives.

useCases.title: Check the financing options for a design
useCases.text: List the financing options of a design: cash, loan, lease or PPA. Read the web proposal link and check if it expired.

useCases.title: Find the design requests that wait for an answer
useCases.text: List the design requests, filtered by status, newest first. Ask the assistant to list the open ones with their projects.

useCases.title: Compare utility bills before and after solar
useCases.text: Read the estimated year-1 bill of a project without solar. Read the bill of a design with solar. Ask the assistant to show the difference.

useCases.title: Update the status and note of a project
useCases.text: Read the current note of a project first. Then change the status after the customer signs, and replace the note with the new text.
